name: vote_escrow
description: Pins the vote-escrow lock/decay/withdraw curve: boost at creation, linear decay across the lock, flat at maturity, zero after withdrawal -- plus get_past_votes and get_past_total_supply at a historical ledger. Harness configures min_lock_duration=100, max_lock_duration=1100, max_multiplier_bps=10000 (100% / 2x boost at max duration).

steps.description: duration 600 of [100,1100] range -> applicable_bps 5000 -> boost 500 -> initial_voting_power 1500
at creation (ledger == start_ledger), power == initial_voting_power (full boost)
halfway through the 600-ledger lock: boost decayed linearly from 500 to 250
amount 1000 -> 2000; initial_voting_power recomputed over the lock's original full duration -> 3000
same decay fraction (remaining 300 / duration 600) applied to the new 1000-unit boost
new_duration 1100 == max_lock_duration -> full max_multiplier_bps applies -> boost 2000, initial_voting_power 4000
ledger 551: exactly the midpoint of the extended [1, 1101) lock
boost decayed to half (1000 of 2000) at the midpoint of the extended lock
get_past_votes at the current ledger, while the lock is still live, matches the live value
get_past_total_supply reads the TotalLocked checkpoint as of ledger 551 (set when the amount was increased to 2000 at ledger 301; the extend at ledger 301 didn't change TotalLocked)
at and after maturity, power is flat at the locked amount (no more boost, no decay below principal)
withdrawn locks report zero current voting power
get_past_votes still reconstructs the pre-withdrawal curve from lock history at a ledger within [start, end) of the final lock shape
